_about: Blind fluency verdicts on 348 f11_l2 Chinese continuations, 58 models x 6. Judged by 12 Claude Opus 5 agents via meta/M06_generation/scripts/m06_zh_fluency_judge.js, each reading one batch file and seeing NO model identity. Scale: fluent/flawed/broken/not_chinese. Join with zh_fluency_sample.json via m06_zh_fluency_join.py.
